summary.text: Pilar Schiavo was elected to the California State Assembly in November 2022 and re-elected in 2024 to represent the 40th Assembly District, covering the Northwest San Fernando Valley, Val Verde, Castaic and the Santa Clarita Valley.

paragraphs.text: She chairs the Assembly Committee on Military and Veterans Affairs.
Before her election, Schiavo was a nurse advocate and small business owner who worked in the labor movement for more than 20 years; she lives in Chatsworth.
